description: Create Tidigar roadmaps and Gantt charts as share links, or read and update plans in Tidigar Business or Tidigar Server.

interface.shortDescription: Create plans and work with your Tidigar Business plans
interface.longDescription: Plan with your AI assistant. Create a plan as a share link without a Tidigar account, or connect your assistant to read and update your organisation’s plans in Tidigar Business or Tidigar Server. Share links carry a separate copy; updates to stored plans keep everyone working on the same plan.
defaultPrompt: Make a Tidigar Gantt chart of this project plan.
Turn these milestones into a Tidigar roadmap grouped by team.
Move the launch in this Tidigar link two weeks later.
